items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: He was playing with Oliver. We used to go up at the St. Catherine Hall, that was their home and most of the time they played.

ctx.x: Who was he playing with at the time you heard him? Who was he playing with? Playing with the, with the,

Stella Starr, not Stella Starr, Oliver. He was playing with Oliver. We used to go up at the St. Catherine Hall, that was their home and most of the time they played. St. Catherine Hall? St. Catherine Hall.
